notes.title: Update notes for 2, 1, 6
notes.content:
This update includes:
[list]
[*] Falling rocks are less dangerous: fixed a case of falling rocks hitting the miner when they shouldn't.
[*] Buying a new lamp now comes with a full tank of fuel.
[*] Added a drill fuel tank bar to the HUD.
[*] Added drill fuel, light fuel and bag storage indicator bars to the shop screen.
[*] Lower value gems (citrine and rhodolite) are now much quicker to dig.
[*] Falling ladders now land on top of lifts, rather than falling to the bottom.
[*] Reduced the "stickiness" of lift platforms. Pressing up or down away from a platform no longer teleports the miner back to the lift.
[*] Fixed the top of lifts being covered by dirt from a cave-in.
[*] Fixed parachutes not closing when the miner lands on a lift platform.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback on these issues!
Happy digging.

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year, everyone!

The game is now on sale, so it's a great time to jump in and play if you haven't already.

To celebrate, we have a new update with:
[list]
[*] Parachutes! This new item will save your miner from a high fall.
[*] The shop keeper has decked-out their shop with New Year's decorations.
[*] Tightened up the miner's movement responsiveness.
[*] Reduced accidental pickaxe swings when holding down the dig button.
[*] Crash reporting is now easier. Reports can now be sent directly from the game.
[/list]

Happy digging!


P.S. Happy 牛 year, haha

notes.title: Peaceful mode
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone! Hope you all had a good relaxing holiday. To celebrate the end of a
stressful 2020 we have added a new game mode.

[*] A warning is given before rocks fall
[*] Jumping enabled on the top of ladders
[*] New peaceful mode outfit
[/list]

notes.title: Dev post #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
The update for version two of MDD is almost finished and we’re busy testing the game. Until this point the focus has been on improving things while keeping the original gameplay (well, mostly the same. I’ll discuss this more in a future post.) I’m pretty happy with the extra polish and quality-of-life improvements we’ve added since the XBLIG version, and now it’s time for something new!
As this is the first time any new gameplay has been added to the original, I thought the version two label was in order. This version introduces different game modes, the first of which is peaceful mode. Peaceful mode includes:
[list]
[*] Never lose any gems or ore when fainting.
[*] Rocks give plenty of warning before they fall.
[*] There are no cave-ins.
[*] The miner character can jump off the top of ladders.
[*] A nifty green outfit for your miner.
[/list]
After the release on Steam, we saw a bit of a split in the feedback, most of you enjoyed playing the original, but some felt the the game wasn’t quite relaxing enough. I hope the introduction of game modes gives you all an experience that suits. As always, we’re looking forward to your feedback.

The new update is planned for release on the 3rd of Feb.

tags.feature: This version introduces different game modes, the first of which is peaceful mode.
Never lose any gems or ore when fainting.
Rocks give plenty of warning before they fall.
There are no cave-ins.
The miner character can jump off the top of ladders.
A nifty green outfit for your miner.

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
It's that time of year again, Christmas has come to Miner: Dig Deep.

The winter update includes:
[list]
[*] Winter is here: lots of snow, Christmas trees, lights, and more!  (Temporary during the winter break.)
[*] Mines created near Christmas have ice platforms underground.
[*] Digging is now possible while on a grabhook.
[*] Improved gamepad controls for getting on and off lifts.
[*] Blueprints are no longer included in post-game mines.
[*] Added an option to toggle between displaying a window and fullscreen.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! We hope you enjoy the new update, and have a relaxing, safe and happy break!

Merry Christmas, everyone!

notes.title: The second patch
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have another patch with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] Falling boulders are a little more forgiving. When you're only a little bit too close, the boulder will push you aside.
[*] Screen shakes can now be reduced. Available in the options menu.
[*] Cave-ins are now shorter and less frequent.
[*] Fixed an issue with cave-ins going for too long in areas containing a large number of lifts.
[/list]

Thanks again to you all for giving us your feedback on these issues!

We hope you enjoy this new patch.
